globalStyle.continuity: Chapter 1 follows one young seeker and one elder guide from dawn to night. The visual story moves from trying to define the Dao, to seeing names fail, to watching the world arise, to learning how desire changes perception, and finally to entering the gate of mystery.

chapters.title: 道可道
chapters.storyArc: A continuous comic sequence: a young seeker tries to fix the Dao with tools and names, then an elder guide leads him from road, workshop, primordial vision, valley, sprout, river boundary, hidden spring, and moon gates. The chapter teaches that formulas and names are useful but incomplete; not-wanting and wanting reveal different faces of one deep source.

elder guide with long white beard in plain undyed linen robe

Dominant visual themes: virtue, language, dao. Every panel shares the same two travelers and album style, but each sentence gets a different setting, focal object, action, camera distance, and emotional beat.
